title: PeerTube Client API compatibility layer
description: Implement PeerTube API endpoints so existing PeerTube clients/apps work with gaja. Key endpoints: /api/v1/videos (CRUD), /api/v1/video-channels (CRUD), /api/v1/videos/{id}/comment-threads (threaded comments mapped to AP replies), /api/v1/users/me/video-playlists, /api/v1/jobs (transcode queue). Completely different schema from Mastodon API — needs its own router and serialization.
close_reason: PeerTube video mode complete. videos_db (28 tests, 7 tables), FFmpeg command builder (8 tests), PeerTube API v1 (13 endpoints) in all 3 servers. Write endpoints stubbed 501 pending transcoding worker.
